mapper.sql: id, message_no, conversation_id, run_id, role, sequence_no, visible_to_user, status, revision_no, supersedes_message_id, included_in_context, version, content_summary, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by, withdrawn_time, withdrawn_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_message (message_no, conversation_id, run_id, role, sequence_no, visible_to_user, status, revision_no, supersedes_message_id, included_in_context, version, content_summary, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by, withdrawn_time, withdrawn_by) VALUES (#{messageNo}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{role}, #{sequenceNo}, #{visibleToUser}, #{status}, #{revisionNo}, #{supersedesMessageId}, #{includedInContext}, #{version}, #{contentSummary}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy}, #{withdrawnTime}, #{withdrawnBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_message WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM t_ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND visible_to_user = TRUE ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.* FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_run r ON r.id = m.run_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.visible_to_user = TRUE AND m.included_in_context = TRUE AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.context_active = TRUE AND (#{excludeRunId} IS NULL OR m.run_id != #{excludeRunId}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent_messages ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.* FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_run r ON r.id = m.run_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.visible_to_user = TRUE AND m.included_in_context = TRUE AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.context_active = TRUE ORDER BY r.turn_no ASC, m.sequence_no ASC, m.id ASC
